title: The Acropolis
subtitle: Standing above Athens, where ancient history and our own journey came together.
introduction: Few places connect the ancient world with the present as powerfully as the Acropolis.
Walking the same ground traveled by generations before us made the experience feel larger than a sightseeing stop.

highlights.title: The Erechtheion
highlights.description: Known for the Porch of the Caryatids.
